title: Shared Mobility Enterprises (Control and Licensing) Bill
what_it_is: Shared Mobility Enterprises (Control and Licensing) Bill

sections.label: Bill replaces parking licensing regime
sections.summary: The Bill replaces the licensing regime for such services from the Parking Places Act and expands it for more comprehensive coverage, linked to the Active Mobility (Amendment) Bill 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Bill replaces the relevant licensing regime of such services from the Parking Places Act and expands the licensing regime for more comprehensive coverage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This Bill is linked to the previous Bill in our Order Paper, the Active Mobility (Amendment) Bill 2020.
